cases.title: R08 probe 4: first-ever pit pick with no U before it, then a plain line/U/REDO round, then two pit-pick rounds
cases.plan_item: BUG-861 characterisation (R08 round 1 fails on Civil 3.0.75)
cases.expected: The first click selects pit 109D56 (read back). The probe records whether REDO then works after a plain line/U (no pick) and after the next two line/U/pick rounds; it does not judge CE.
cases.why_not_unit: Whether REDO survives depends on what happens in a real AutoCAD undo stack in the seconds after a pick.
not_automated: This is a probe for the R08 question only; it is not a feature test and is never accepted.
